QuestInfo.name: [Kerning Tower] Day One as a Casting Manager
QuestInfo.0: Hear about the basics of casting from #b#p1052212##k before you leave.
QuestInfo.1: You learn the ins and outs of casting from #p1052212#. She says the best place to start casting is right here in Kerning Tower. Start your search at #r#m910310502##k for now.
QuestInfo.2: You met the street performer Ruthie Bea in the Kerning Tower Lobby.

0.0: Let me give you some casting pointers before you go. First, find someone with the potential to be a real star! Second, when you do find that someone, approach them calmly and naturally! Third, hand them a business card, and that's it!
0.1: Oh, one more thing! Kerning Tower is brimming with aspiring musicians and other talent. You may not even need to leave the building to find our new star!
0.2: There should be plenty of people at #r#m910310502##k. Why not start there and work your way up?

yes.0: Well then, I'll trust your judgment!

no.0: There's this saying, 'If you're looking for trees, go to the forest.' Simple but true, so shouldn't you go to #r#m103041000##k first?
